lines.en: Morning. What's the plan for today?
lines.ru: Доброе утро. Какой план на сегодня?

lines.en: We start on the ground floor slab.
lines.ru: Начинаем с плиты на первом этаже.

lines.en: Do we need barriers up first?
Yes. Put the barriers around the open edge.
lines.ru: Да. Поставь ограждения вокруг открытого края.

lines.en: OK, I'll set them now.
Good. Then wait for the pour team.
Where do these bags go?
Take them to bay three.
Is the hoist free?
Use the hoist. Don't carry them up the stairs.
lines.ru: Используй подъёмник. Не тащи по лестнице.

lines.en: Got it. How many trips?
Four trips should cover it.
Is this area closed?
Yes. Live works behind that tape.
lines.ru: Да. За лентой — работы под напряжением.

lines.en: Who can go in?
Only the authorised crew with permits.
I'll stay outside then.
Good. Keep clear until I call you.
lines.ru: Хорошо. Не заходи, пока не позову.

lines.en: I need access to that cable tray.
lines.ru: Мне нужен доступ к тому лотку.

lines.en: Use the podium steps, not the wooden ladder.
Are the wheels locked?
Check the brakes before you climb.
Brakes are on. Climbing now.
Someone foot the base if it wobbles.
lines.ru: Если шатается — пусть кто-то придержит основание.

say_today.en: I need access to that cable tray.
say_today.ru: Мне нужен доступ к тому лотку.

lines.en: The trunking delivery is late.
How late?
They said after lunch, maybe three.
lines.ru: Сказали после обеда, может в три.

lines.en: Call the supplier and get a firm time.
lines.ru: Позвони поставщику и возьми точное время.

lines.en: OK. Should I switch to another task?
Yes — pull cable on level two meanwhile.
lines.ru: Да — пока тяни кабель на втором уровне.

say_today.en: Should I switch to another task?

lines.en: Wind is picking up on the roof.
What's the reading?
About forty kilometres an hour.
Stop roof work. Tie down loose sheets.
lines.ru: Стоп работы на крыше. Закрепите свободные листы.

lines.en: We'll move inside to the plant room.
Good call. Report when you're clear.

say_today.en: Wind is picking up on the roof.

lines.en: Can you check my marks before I drill?
Show me the centres.
Two hundred mil from the corner, level.
lines.ru: Двести миллиметров от угла, по уровню.

lines.en: Looks right. Scan for cables first.
lines.ru: Похоже верно. Сначала просканируй на кабели.

lines.en: Scanner is clear. Drilling now.
Use dust extraction.

say_today.en: Check my marks before I drill.

lines.en: Plumbers are in the same riser.
Talk to their lead before you pull.
lines.ru: Поговори с их бригадиром до протяжки.

lines.en: They need one more hour for the pipe.
lines.ru: Им нужен ещё час на трубу.

lines.en: Then wait. Don't fight for space.
lines.ru: Тогда подожди. Не спорьте за место.

lines.en: I'll prep terminations outside.
Perfect. Keep the doorway clear.

say_today.en: Plumbers are in the same riser.

lines.en: What do you need before we leave?
Sweep the area and lock the container.
Tools are back on the board.
Sign the handover sheet for night shift.
Done. Anything left open?
No. See you tomorrow at seven.

say_today.en: Tools are back on the board.

lines.en: I cut my hand on the metal edge.
How bad is it?
It's bleeding but not deep.
Go to the first aid point now.
lines.ru: Сейчас иди в пункт первой помощи.

lines.en: Should I fill an incident form?
Yes, after they bandage you.

say_today.en: Should I fill an incident form?

lines.en: The client is asking about the delay.
Be honest and short.
We waited on materials; we restart after lunch.
Good. Don't promise a finish time yet.
lines.ru: Хорошо. Пока не обещай время сдачи.

lines.en: Understood. I'll walk them to the safe path.
Thanks. Stay with them until they leave.
lines.ru: Спасибо. Будь с ними, пока не уйдут.

say_today.en: I'll walk them to the safe path.

lines.en: Neighbours complained about noise after ten.
lines.ru: Соседи жаловались на шум после десяти.

lines.en: No angle grinders after ten then.
Can we still drill inside?
Only low noise tasks indoors.
We'll switch to labeling and testing.
Yes. Keep voices down near the street.
Where do you want the entrance camera?
Above the door, covering the path in.
lines.ru: Над дверью, чтобы видеть входной путь.

lines.en: Do you need face detail or just movement?
Faces at the door. Movement in the yard.
lines.ru: Лица у двери. Движение во дворе.

lines.en: I'll mark both positions on the plan.
Send me the plan before you drill.

say_today.en: Where do you want the entrance camera?

lines.en: Is this run on PoE?
Yes, from the switch in the office.
Cable length is about eighty metres.
That should be fine for PoE.
I'll test voltage at the camera end.
lines.ru: Проверю напряжение на конце у камеры.

lines.en: Call me if it's low.

say_today.en: I'll test voltage at the camera end.

lines.en: Can I share the same tray as power?
lines.ru: Можно в один лоток с силой?

lines.en: Keep data separate if you can.
There's a spare data tray above.
lines.ru: Сверху есть свободный лоток для данных.

lines.en: Use that. Leave a service loop.
Loop at both ends, labelled.
lines.ru: Петля с обоих концов, с маркировкой.

lines.en: Perfect.

say_today.en: Can I share the same tray as power?
say_today.ru: Можно в один лоток с силой?

lines.en: The NVR is online. Need the admin password.
lines.ru: NVR в сети. Нужен пароль админа.

lines.en: I'll text it. Change it after setup.
Do you want remote view on the phone?
Yes, for me and the night manager.
I'll create two user accounts.
No shared logins, please.
Camera three shows the wall, not the gate.
lines.ru: Камера три смотрит в стену, не на ворота.

lines.en: Can you aim it from the ladder?
Yes. Watch the live view and guide me.
Left a bit… stop. Tilt down.
Gate is centred now.
Lock the bracket and tighten it.
At night the image is washed out.
Street light is opposite the lens.
I can enable WDR or move it slightly.
lines.ru: Могу включить WDR или чуть сдвинуть.

lines.en: Try WDR first.
Better. Faces are readable now.
Save the profile as Night.
Recording stopped on channel two.
Is the disk full?
Disk is healthy. Schedule was off.
lines.ru: Диск в порядке. Расписание было выключено.

lines.en: Turn continuous recording back on.
Done. I'll check twenty-four hours later.
Send me a screenshot of the timeline.
The app can't find the device.
Are you on the site Wi‑Fi?
Yes. Scanning the QR on the NVR.
Allow local network permission on the phone.
lines.ru: Разреши доступ к локальной сети на телефоне.

lines.en: It connected. Live view works.
Add a bookmark named Main gate.

say_today.en: The app can't find the device.

lines.en: Someone cut the cable to camera five.
lines.ru: Кто-то перерезал кабель к камере пять.

lines.en: Can you splice it or pull a new run?
Better to pull a new run — it's crushed.
Do it today if you can.
I'll use the spare conduit path.
Mark it so they don't cut it again.

say_today.en: I'll use the spare conduit path.

lines.en: Handover pack is ready.
What's inside?
IP list, passwords, cable plan, and app guide.
lines.ru: IP, пароли, план кабелей и гайд по приложению.

lines.en: Change default passwords with me now.
Done. Old defaults are disabled.
Sign here and we're closed out.
We're getting false motion alerts.
When?
Every time trees move in the wind.
lines.ru: Каждый раз, когда деревья качает ветром.

lines.en: Raise the sensitivity threshold.
I'll also mask the tree zone.
Test it tonight and message me.
Client wants one more camera in the stock room.
lines.ru: Клиент хочет ещё камеру на складе.

lines.en: Have we got a free PoE port?
Yes, port eight is free.
Add it to the NVR and name it Stock.
lines.ru: Добавь в NVR и назови Stock.

lines.en: Licensed and recording.
Update the site map too.

say_today.en: One more camera in the stock room.

lines.en: Hi, I'm here for the site induction.
Have you got your Safe Pass with you?
Yes, here it is.
Sign in and take a seat in the meeting room.
What time does it start?
In ten minutes. Phones on silent.
lines.ru: Через десять минут. Телефоны на беззвучный.

say_today.en: I'm here for the site induction.
Sign in and take a seat.

lines.en: What PPE do I need on this site?
lines.ru: Какие СИЗ нужны на этом объекте?

lines.en: Hard hat, hi‑vis, safety boots, and glasses.
Are gloves mandatory everywhere?
For cutting and handling materials, yes.
I need a larger hi‑vis.
Store is next to the canteen.
Where is the nearest fire exit?
Follow the green signs to the yard.
Where do we assemble?
Assembly point B by the gate.
Who do I report to after a drill?
Your supervisor with your name checked off.
lines.ru: Своему супервайзеру — вас отметили в списке.

say_today.en: Where is the nearest fire exit?

lines.en: Do I need a permit for hot works?
Yes. No grinding without a permit.
Who signs it?
The area owner and the fire watcher.
lines.ru: Хозяин зоны и наблюдающий за огнём.

lines.en: I'll raise it before I start.
Keep a extinguisher within reach.

say_today.en: Do I need a permit for hot works?
I'll raise it before I start.

lines.en: Is this circuit isolated?
Show me your lock and tag first.
lines.ru: Сначала покажи свой замок и бирку.

lines.en: My lock is on the isolator.
Prove dead before you touch anything.
Tester shows zero. Safe to proceed?
Yes. Keep your lock on until you finish.
lines.ru: Да. Не снимай замок, пока не закончишь.

say_today.en: Prove dead before you touch anything.

lines.en: I saw an uncovered hole near the stairs.
Did you barricade it?
I put cones around it and came to tell you.
Good. We'll get a proper cover on it.
Should I write it in the hazard book?
Yes, and take a photo.

say_today.en: Should I write it in the hazard book?

lines.en: Can I use a ladder for that light?
Only if it's tied and footed.
The podium is free — better?
Yes. Use the podium.
Harness needed above two metres?
Follow the site method statement.
Where are the safety data sheets?
Folder on the wall in the store.
This solvent needs gloves and goggles.
lines.ru: Для этого растворителя нужны перчатки и очки.

lines.en: Correct. Use it only with ventilation.
Where do I dispose of the rags?
Red bin for contaminated waste.

say_today.en: Where are the safety data sheets?
Where do I dispose of the rags?

lines.en: Who is the first aider today?
Maria on channel two.
Where is the first aid kit?
In the welfare cabin, left shelf.
If someone collapses, what do I do first?
lines.ru: Если кто-то упал — что первым делом?

lines.en: Make safe, call first aid, then site manager.
lines.ru: Обезопась, вызови первую помощь, потом менеджера.

say_today.en: Who is the first aider today?
Where is the first aid kit?

lines.en: Where can delivery vans park?
Only in the marked bay by the compound.
lines.ru: Только в размеченной зоне у компаунда.

lines.en: Is reversing without a banksman allowed?
No. Always use a banksman.
I'll radio before the truck enters.
lines.ru: Перед въездом грузовика вызову по рации.

lines.en: Good. Keep pedestrians clear.
Can I open this distribution board?
Only if you're competent and authorised.
I'm waiting for the site electrician.
Don't touch live parts meanwhile.
I'll stay clear and watch the area.
Thanks. Report if anyone removes the cover.
lines.ru: Спасибо. Скажи, если кто снимет крышку.

say_today.en: Can I open this distribution board?

lines.en: Any questions before you start work?
Who do I call if I feel unsafe?
Stop work and call me on channel one.
lines.ru: Стоп работа и звони мне на канал один.

lines.en: Where do I get task briefings?
Every morning with your gang.
Understood. I'm ready to start.

say_today.en: Who do I call if I feel unsafe?

lines.en: Which feeder feeds this board?
F3 from the main switchroom.
I'll lock it off and prove dead.
lines.ru: Отключу, повешу замок и проверю отсутствие.

lines.en: Tag it with your name and time.
Done. Safe to open the cover.
Keep one person as a standby.

say_today.en: I'll lock it off and prove dead.

lines.en: This run is 2.5 but the schedule says 4.
Stop and don't terminate yet.
Should I pull new cable?
Yes, from the drum in bay two.
lines.ru: Да, с барабана во втором отсеке.

lines.en: I'll label both ends before I pull.
Good. Update the as‑built after.
Socket in room 12 is dead.
Check the MCB and the RCD first.
MCB is on. RCD tripped.
Find the fault before you reset.
There's a nicked cable in the skirting.
Repair it, test insulation, then reset.
Are these fittings LED drivers included?
lines.ru: В этих светильниках драйверы в комплекте?

lines.en: Yes. Keep polarity correct.
Neutral is blue, live brown — OK?
Yes. Earth to the metal body.
First six are up. Testing next.
Megger the circuit before energising.
Half the breakers have no labels.
Trace and label before energising the floor.
lines.ru: Проследи и подпиши до включения этажа.

lines.en: Can I use temporary tags tonight?
Temporary OK, permanent tomorrow.
I'll photo the schedule for the pack.
Add it to the handover folder.
Mains outage starts at two.
Is the generator fuelled?
Check oil and fuel, then do a test run.
lines.ru: Проверь масло и топливо, потом тестовый пуск.

lines.en: Test run OK. Changeover ready.
Keep essential circuits only.
Lighting and CCTV only, agreed.
How deep should this chase be?
Deep enough for the conduit plus cover.
lines.ru: Чтобы труба и слой закрытия влезли.

lines.en: Metal or plastic conduit here?
Plastic in walls, metal where exposed.
lines.ru: Пластик в стенах, металл где открыто.

lines.en: I'll vacuum before plastering.
Don't leave sharp edges on the chase.

say_today.en: How deep should this chase be?

lines.en: Time to test the RCDs on this board.
lines.ru: Пора тестить УЗО на этом щите.

lines.en: I'll use the tester and log the times.
Anything over the limit?
One is slow. I'll replace it.
Retest after replacement.
Retest passed. Logged.
Client wants two more sockets in the office.
lines.ru: Клиент хочет ещё две розетки в офисе.

lines.en: Is there spare capacity on that ring?
Yes, load is low. I can spur carefully.
lines.ru: Да, нагрузка низкая. Аккуратно сделаю отвод.

lines.en: Get a variation number first.
Variation approved. Starting after lunch.
Update drawings when finished.

say_today.en: Two more sockets in the office.

lines.en: Breaker trips instantly when I close it.
Leave it off. Check for a short.
Found a screw through the cable.
Repair the cable and inspect neighbours.
Repair done. Insulation OK.
Energise with me watching.
Photocell isn't switching the yard lights.
lines.ru: Фотореле не включает свет во дворе.

lines.en: Bypass it temporarily for tonight?
I can put it on manual until we replace it.
lines.ru: Поставлю на ручной, пока не заменим.

lines.en: Order a new photocell tomorrow.
Manual is on. Lights stay on overnight.
Tell security so they know.
Certificates ready for this floor?
IR tests and RCD times are in the folder.
lines.ru: IR и времена УЗО в папке.

lines.en: Any open snags?
Two labels left. I'll finish them now.
Photo the board schedule too.
Done. Ready to sign off.
I need a Torx T20 for these screws.
lines.ru: Нужен Torx T20 для этих винтов.

lines.en: Check the red case in the van.
Found it. Bits were mixed up.
Sort the case at break.
Will do. Starting these panels now.
Don't strip the heads.
Laser level battery is dead.
Spare is charging in the office.
Can I use a spirit level meanwhile?
Yes for short runs only.
I'll swap batteries in twenty minutes.
Bring the empty one back to charge.
The drill is overheating.
Are you using the right bit for concrete?
Yes, SDS, but dust is packing the hole.
lines.ru: Да, SDS, но пыль забивает отверстие.

lines.en: Clear the hole and let the tool cool.
lines.ru: Прочисти отверстие и дай инструменту остыть.

lines.en: Cooling now. I'll finish after five minutes.
Use extraction next time.
Whose meter is this on the bench?
That's Tom's. Don't take it.
Mine is in for calibration.
Borrow the site spare from the store.
Got the spare. Tagged against my name.
Return it before you leave.
This step ladder has a bent foot.
Red tag it. Do not use.
Where do condemned tools go?
Quarantine cage by the stores.
Tagged and moved. Grabbing another.
Check the next one before you climb.
My cable stripper is missing.
Look in the shared toolbox.
Found it without a handle grip.
Still usable? Or replace?
I'll replace it — grip is gone.
Put the order on the board.
We need a longer lead to the saw.
Use a 110 volt lead only.
Is daisy‑chaining allowed?
No. One lead, correct length.
I'll get the 20 metre yellow lead.
Keep it out of puddles.
Both battery packs are flat.
Swap with the charged set upstairs.
Charged set is there. Leaving empties on charge.
lines.ru: Заряженные есть. Пустые ставлю на зарядку.

lines.en: Don't leave packs in the cold van overnight.
lines.ru: Не оставляй их ночью в холодном фургоне.

lines.en: Understood. I'll bring them inside.
Label which pack is weak.
Site SDS drill isn't free. Rent one?
lines.ru: Объектовый перфоратор занят. Взять в аренду?

lines.en: Call the hire desk for half a day.
They can deliver at noon.
Book it. Keep the paperwork.
Booked. Job number is on the docket.
Return with a full battery if cordless.
lines.ru: Верни с полным зарядом, если аккумуляторный.

say_today.en: Rent one for half a day?

lines.en: Torque wrench sticker is out of date.
Don't use it for terminations then.
Is there a calibrated spare?
Yes, blue case in the test kit.
Using the blue one. Sending the old for cal.
lines.ru: Беру синий. Старый отправлю на калибровку.

lines.en: Log the serial in the folder.

say_today.en: Blue case in the test kit.

lines.en: Tool trolley is a mess again.
lines.ru: Тележка с инструментом снова в хаосе.

lines.en: I'll sort it before lunch.
Shadow board stickers are peeling.
Replace them this week.
Sorted. Missing one pliers set.
Check the last room you worked in.
Inventory check in ten minutes.
I'll bring everything back to the container.
Any tool left on site overnight?
lines.ru: Что-то остаётся на ночь на объекте?

lines.en: No. All back, locked.
Sign the sheet then.
Signed. See you tomorrow.

lessons.title_en: Site commands: get / bring / cut / give me
lessons.scene_ru: Бригадир даёт короткие команды на объекте.

lines.en: Go get the drill.
OK, I will go get it.
Take it and bring it here.
I will bring it here.
Go cut that trunking.
Give me that over there.
Here you are.
Give me something to mark with.
